name: San Joaquin Spaghetti
notes:
I usually double this for 6-7 hearty eaters.

On July 22nd, 2017, Luke (in Pittsburgh for the summer with Lara) chopped up his left thumb with an immersion blender while blending walnuts to make this recipe. Undeterred, Luke and Lara returned to the kitchen (after an hour and a half at prompt care and with five stitches in Luke’s thumb) to continue making dinner. Sweat and tears were added for good measure.

steps.title: Blend the walnuts
steps.body: Place in a blender and blend to a smooth texture: **½ cup shelled walnuts**, **¼ tsp dried thyme**, crushed, **½ tsp salt** and **1 garlic clove**, crushed.

steps.title: Add the oil and water
steps.body: Slowly pour **2 Tbsp olive oil** into the blended nut mixture, with **¼ cup warm water**.

steps.title: Toss the spaghetti
steps.body: Toss the spaghetti with nut mixture, then add **¼ cup grated parmesan cheese**.

steps.title: Toss again and top
steps.body: Toss again, and top with **2 Tbsp chopped walnuts**.
